bio.text: Hope Duke represents District 12 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes Gravette, Maysville, Sulphur Springs, Decatur and Bella Vista, and is serving her second term.

Duke graduated from the University of Arkansas, Fayetteville, with a degree in education. She worked as a real estate agent and executive broker and served on the Gravette School Board for six years, ending in 2022.
